itemList.description: Complete Service of 62.5kva Diesel Generator Set: Service includes Engine Oil Change, Replacement of Oil Filter, Replacement of Fuel Filter, Replacement of Water Separator. Checking of Coolant Level and Condition: Inspect level and concentration to prevent overheating or internal corrosion. Check for Fan Belt Tension aging, cracking, or looseness. If in case any damage replacement of those. Clean or replacement of air filter as needed. On dusty construction sites, this is especially important to prevent power loss, black smoke, and reduced performance. Battery Inspection: A leading cause of failure to start. Check voltage, electrolyte level maintain the level and clean any corrosion on terminals. Rate including labour charges.
